Acme to buy Beta Systems for $1.2 billion

Acme Inc. agreed on Tuesday to acquire Beta Systems in a deal valued at $1.2 billion, the companies said in a joint statement.

The acquisition gives Acme a larger presence in industrial software, and the boards of both companies have approved the terms of the transaction.

The deal is expected to close in the first quarter of next year, subject to regulatory approval and the usual closing conditions for a transaction of this size.
